paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.58% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+0.76%) and Hang Seng weakest (-3.46%). Brent crude changed +1.39% to 110.3. Gold changed -2.94% to 4,020.8. Bitcoin changed -1.67% to 79,951.6406. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.986%, a relative move of -2.92%. Among the firms tracked, Blackstone (+11.18%) and Vale (-8.47%) moved the most.
